body: I noticed the disappointment etched on my partner’s face as they arrived late for our third consecutive meeting. My heart was heavy with frustration but also a sense of urgency to address this issue head-on. Instead of immediately confronting them, I took a deep breath and decided to start small. Maybe we could have a brief chat about what we’re working through, how we can improve communication, or set some clear expectations for future meetings. It might not fix everything overnight, but it would at least show respect and a willingness to collaborate constructively.
